# Typography

Font sizes and line heights come from tokens. Body text allows system fallback and dynamic type; compact panels do not use hero-scale headings.

## Overview

Font sizes and line heights come from tokens. Body text allows system fallback and dynamic type; compact panels do not use hero-scale headings.

## Visual Example

<FoundationExamples kind="typography" />

## Guidelines

Choose type by information role, avoid display headings in compact panels, and never scale type from viewport width.

## Usage

Components consume semantic/component tokens. Products override through Theme or ConfigProvider instead of copying values into local styles.

## Tokens

Use [Token Explorer](/en/foundations/token-explorer) for the source, Light/Dark values, and four-platform mappings.

## Platform Notes

Vue uses CSS variables; Flutter uses ThemeExtension; Compose uses CompositionLocal; SwiftUI uses Environment. Semantics align while syntax remains native.

## Source of Truth

Change tokens/tokens.json, run npm run generate, and never edit tokens/dist or native token files directly.

## Validation

npm run check:generated checks generated drift, dark-mode completeness, and token contracts; visual changes remain in each platform regression suite.
